تستوزروا (form X)
# تَسْتَوْزِرُوا (tastawzirū) /tas.taw.zi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# تُسْتَوْزَرُوا (tustawzarū) /tus.taw.za.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
